text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Loves Only You visited a mountain
together with Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For our scenario... shall we assume we got
lost in the mountains while trekking?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Fufu, I'm really looking forward to it!
Tact-chan's survival skills lecture!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You wish to accompany me on my mountain retreat?
Of course, I don't mind at all... but why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's because... I want to learn
even more about survival techniques!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I heard a story recently from a community member who
camped out in the wild with just a single knife... and thought it sounded so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"So, I really wanted to experience it myself...
Would it be okay if I joined in?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, Loves-san.
First, let's secure some drinking water!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes, Tact-sensei!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Amazing, amazing! Just like Tact-chan said, there was a mountain stream nearby!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I saw river willows—plants that naturally grow by the water's edge—so I figured a water source must be close by.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, brilliant!
That takes care of the water problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. Even raw water that looks clean
can still contain impurities and pathogens—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's secure a fire for boiling!
...By the way, there's something I'd like to ask—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to starting a fire,
there's the 'easy method' and the 'hard method'...
Which one would you like to try?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... In that case,
I'll take the one that takes more effort, please!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Set the stick into the notch on the board...
—...Heave... hooo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Applying your body weight from above is key!
By doing that, you create frictional heat—
Yes, exactly! You're a quick learner.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, we were able to make the board out of cedar, an easily ignitable softwood...
At this rate, we'll definitely make it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Loves-san.
There's actually an easier way to do this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The idea is to fill a plastic bottle with water
and use it like a magnifying glass to focus the light
and start a fire, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...No, let me try just a little more!
I feel like I'm finally getting the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*! ...Huh, we're here?!
...I did it. Finally... I did iiiiiit!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing! That's incredible, Loves-san! The corkscrew style takes real skill!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu. Really? You think so?
You know, you're welcome to praise me even more ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious♡ Even the coffee tastes sweet!
After all that hard work, the sense of accomplishment makes it taste even better!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. They've been on you for nearly
an hour now. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Your refusal to give up was wonderful.
You're always up for a challenge, Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm happy you praised me♡
But you see, I—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm just curious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Worlds I don't know. Cultures I don't know... There are so many, right? I want to know more about them.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I gain knowledge—
I can share it with everyone."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to entertain everyone like that. That's why
I just can't help wanting to touch everything♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I see... Heheh.
What a reason full of love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, she told me about the time she accompanied Daring Tact on her mountain retreat.
choice_data_list: So with actual fire? That's amazing!
So with actual fire? That's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Also, I learned how to clean a fish!
I'm thinking of showing it on stream next time...
What do you think, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: You learned how to clean and fillet fish?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Also, I learned how to clean a fish!
I'm thinking of showing it on stream next time...
What do you think, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: You learned how to clean and fillet fish?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And what's more,
I can even make the rods from scratch now.
choice_data_list: What?! This is way too authentic...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. As long as you have a single knife, you can handle almost anything, you know? Did you know that?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep sharing things about worlds
you don't know about, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's true...! It's an important act of receiving a life, but some girls just can't handle it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How about a fish habitat quiz, then?
I'll announce the correct answers by catching them on-site!
choice_data_list: Isn't that way too long to wait for the answer...！？

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. But my dear Bridges—
you'd watch me for hours and hours, wouldn't you? Right?♡
